definitions.explanation: A question asked to get information or an answer. The noun form of {問|と}う (to ask, to question). More formal than {質問|しつもん}.

examples.japanese: {問|と}いに{答|こた}えてください。
この{問|と}いには{正解|せいかい}がない。
examples.english: This question has no correct answer.

examples.japanese: {人生|じんせい}の{意味|いみ}を{問|と}いかける。
examples.english: To question the meaning of life.
examples.notes: 問いかける = to pose a question, to inquire

notes:
USAGE: {問|と}い is a somewhat formal or literary word for 'question'. In everyday speech, {質問|しつもん} is more common.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{問|と}いに{答|こた}える (to answer a question)
・{問|と}いかける (to pose a question, to inquire)
・{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ (inquiry, query - often business/customer service)
・{問|と}い{合|あ}わせる (to make an inquiry)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ{先|さき} (contact information)
・{問|と}い{合|あ}わせフォーム (inquiry form)
・{問題|もんだい} (problem, question)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{質問|しつもん} - question (everyday, neutral)
・{疑問|ぎもん} - doubt, question (implying skepticism)
・{問題|もんだい} - problem, question, issue
